exposure: Birth mode (Cesarean section or vaginal delivery)
cohort: 144 adult women from two U.S. studies
finding: This pilot cross-sectional study suggests a possible association between C-section and Molecular-BV in adulthood, with women born by C-section having 3-fold higher odds of Molecular-BV compared to vaginally-delivered women in one study site.
mod_finding: Women born by C-section had 3-fold higher odds of Molecular-BV compared to vaginally-delivered women in one study site.
